why_not: I already drop slides into ChatGPT or NotebookLM and share past-exam summaries in my Zalo study group for free, so in a normal week I wouldn't pay for a new cram site, especially when joining friends' Arena rooms and testing one PDF are free anyway.

I already have a free stack that works—NotebookLM eats 150+ lecture slides in seconds, free ChatGPT walks me through Corporate Finance formulas step by step, and our campus Zalo and Google Drive banks have actual past midterms from my professors. Even with an untimed mode toggle and a $1.90 or $3.99 price tag, I'm not paying for an AI quiz wrapper when my free tabs already cover my 48-hour cram.

I appreciate the one-time Apple Pay setup with zero auto-renewal, but I'm not paying $3.99 in a normal week for a cram pass when I already use free ChatGPT and NotebookLM. A 'Dual-Model Math Verifier' still sounds like two AIs that can both miss a finance or calculus subscript, and a $3.99 refund doesn't save my grade if I study the wrong formula.

Free ChatGPT, NotebookLM, and campus Drive exam banks already cost $0, and since AI tools have burned me on quant formulas before, I'd still end up checking every step myself. As a TA and tutor in a normal week, I'd rather stick to the Drive past papers and my own worked notes than pay for another PDF cram tool.

I only start cramming 48 hours before midterms, so in a normal week I'm not pulling out VietQR or Apple Pay to pre-buy an exam pass—even if the 7-day clock stays paused. Since there's a free 1-file preview anyway, I'd scroll past for now rather than pay upfront before I'm actually in exam panic.

In a normal week I'm nowhere near exam panic yet—I don't touch my slides until two or three days before midterms, so I'm not opening my banking app right now to prepay 49,000 VND even if the timer stays paused. At most I'd scroll past or save the free preview link for when I'm actually cramming.

In a normal week I'm not studying for midterms yet, and when I do panic-cram 48 hours before an exam, I expect a classmate will just drop a #pack= link, the 2-page PDF cheat sheet, or a free /arena room invite. Paying 49,000 VND upfront feels unnecessary when free accounts already get the 5-question preview and free joins in friends' rooms.
why_yes: Free ChatGPT and NotebookLM already struggle with my 150-slide decks, so paying 49,000 VND ($1.90) once via VietQR—with no $20/month auto-renewal and a timer that stays paused until Exam Week—is cheap enough for me to try right after testing one real PDF for free.

With my Corporate Finance midterm 48 hours away and 150+ messy slides to review, I'd test the $0 preview on my real PDF first and then pay 49,000 VND once via VietQR—or split the 119,000 VND Zalo 3-pack with two classmates—because there's zero auto-renewal and the 2-page cheat sheet plus 30 worked problems save a whole night of cramming.
